page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is a virtual machine instance from the c4d server family, featuring 192 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 744.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. This configuration includes 16 local SSDs for high-speed local storage, while featuring no graphics processing units.

With its high-density dedicated vCPU allocation and integrated local SSDs, this instance is designed for resource-intensive workloads requiring balanced memory-to-CPU ratios and fast local storage access. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of compute resources and storage devices within a single instance, making it suitable for large-scale deployments that benefit from consolidated hardware. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, data analytics, enterprise applications, and general-purpose high-throughput computing tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family, featuring 192 dedicated vCPUs and 744.0 GB of RAM, yielding 3.88 GB of memory per core. The hardware configuration includes 16 local SSDs to support high-speed local data access, with no integrated GPUs. This server provides a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it highly suitable for general-purpose enterprise workloads, large-scale databases, and data processing tasks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance delivers a dense consolidation of compute cores and local storage resources, minimizing the need for multi-instance overhead in high-throughput environments. It is optimized for workloads requiring substantial parallel processing power and fast local storage I/O.
